entries.rule: Fields on every entry (drug, route, population_group)
entries.note: Clegg 2012 (Cancer Res, epub Jan 2012) quote verbatim in abstract. Opener untested 2012; apalutamide given orally in the LNCaP/AR xenografts; stage_or_line CRPC fits.

entries.rule: Retrodiction (engagement is a target claim); evidence rule 6
entries.note: Rathkopf 2013 quote verbatim (14/30, 46.7%). Retro right: enzalutamide CRPC PSA falls (Scher 2010) predate Clegg 2012. ASCO GU 2012 abstract 43 (2012-02-10) reported 55% PSA>=50% falls and FDHT-PET AR blockade: year 2012.
Clegg 2012 abstract: maximal xenograft response at 30 mg/kg/d and wider therapeutic index; FDA review gives ~160 ug*h/mL projection. Apalutamide, oral, CRPC correct. Opener untested 2012.

Same holds, not retro (Clegg Jan 2012 precedes apalutamide patient data). But ASCO GU 2012 abstract 43 (2012-02-10) already states 240 mg RP2D chosen on preclinical maximum efficacious dose, no DLT to 300 mg: year 2013 -> 2012.
entries.adjudication_note: Rule 6: ASCO GU 2012 abstract 43 (JCO 30:5_suppl 43) already states 240 mg RP2D from preclinical maximum efficacious dose, no further DLT to 300 mg; status same, year 2012 not 2013. Not retro: Clegg Jan 2012 precedes.

entries.note: Clegg 2012 abstract quote verbatim; LNCaP/AR regressions with oral apalutamide. Opener untested 2012; drug, route, population_group correct.

entries.rule: Retrodiction (efficacy is a target claim); evidence rule 6
entries.note: Smith 2016 primary 12-week PSA response 89% confirmed. ESMO 2012 abstract (Ann Oncol 23 suppl 9, ix303, 2012-09) states 17/19 (89.5%) PSA response, primary endpoint: year 2012. Retro right: enzalutamide CRPC efficacy (2010) predates the 2012 model.

entries.rule: Retrodiction (safety: same drug's earlier patient result)
entries.note: FDA review NDA 210951 quote verbatim. Retro right: dog convulsions first public in the Feb 2018 label/review, after SPARTAN seizures (NEJM epub 2018-02-08). Apalutamide, oral, nmCRPC correct. Track still lacks a 2010 untested opener.
Moilanen 2015 (Sci Rep) quote verbatim in abstract; darolutamide oral in castration-resistant VCaP xenografts; 2009 first-use proxy from FDA review study number acceptable.

entries.rule: Retrodiction (efficacy: any drug on the target)
entries.note: Quote verbatim in abstract. Retro right: model first public 2015 after enzalutamide (2010) and ARADES (Lancet Oncol 2014; 12-week PSA response primary) CRPC results. Darolutamide, oral, mCRPC stage_or_line correct.
Joseph 2013 abstract quote verbatim; resistant lines derived under ARN-509; drug apalutamide, oral; opener 2013 correct.
Quote verbatim. Same kept: no patient F876L result was public before this paper (Korpal/Balbas 2013 were preclinical), so not a retrodiction. Drug apalutamide, oral, progressing CRPC correct.

entries.rule: Untested for conditions the model never tested; rule 5
entries.note: Zhou 2020 (EJC) quote verbatim. Kintor's interim rPFS miss (tier 5) was in post-NHA mCRPC, a population the xenograft never tested: untested/unsettled right. Pruxelutamide, oral correct.
Moilanen 2015 abstract quote verbatim; darolutamide oral; brain:plasma 0.02 and no CNS signs in rat/dog per FDA review. Opener 2015 correct.

entries.rule: Retrodiction (safety: same drug's earlier patient result)
entries.note: FDA review NDA 212099 quote confirmed; ARAMIS seizures 0.2% both arms. Not retro: no darolutamide seizure result (ARADES 2014 abstract reports none) preceded the 2015 model. Darolutamide, oral, nmCRPC correct.

IJC 2023 quote verbatim; primary endpoint PSA response, three doses, no control, so single-arm rule and retro right; NHA-pretreated patients excluded, matching the model. ASCO GU 2021 abstract 108 (print 2021-02-20) already reported PSA50 41.9%: year 2021.
entries.adjudication_note: Rule 6: ASCO GU 2021 abstract 108 (JCO 39:6_suppl 108) reported PSA50 41.9% across three doses; year 2021 not 2023. Single-arm rule; model (2020) post-dates class CRPC results, so retro.

missing: Proxalutamide (pruxelutamide, a class member) has an in-vivo model: Zhou 2020 Eur J Cancer, doi:10.1016/j.ejca.2020.04.013 (PMID 32460179), 'The efficacy of GT0918 was investigated in a castration-resistant xenograft model' plus phase 1 (PSA>=50% in 2/16). The draft's claim that its preclinical work is cell lines only is wrong. Kintor announced (Sept 2020 IDMC; tier 5, e.g. Kintor 2020 interim results, en.kintor.com.cn/news/131.html) that the 2L+ mCRPC phase 3 missed interim rPFS. It needs its own model_id entry in efficacy: probably untested (model never tested post-abiraterone/docetaxel disease), otherwise contra. The trial population was not verified.

Darolutamide's own model (castration-resistant VCaP xenograft; FDA review NDA 212099, lines ~1364-1378) is only mentioned in a judgement. As a different system, it should get its own model_id entries (efficacy vs ARADES NCT01317641 / ARAMIS; safety, where mouse brain:plasma was low and ARAMIS seizures were 0.2% in both arms).

Rezvilutamide (SHR3680): CHART phase 3 in high-volume mHSPC was positive, but no published in-vivo model was found, so no entry is needed. TRC-253 (JNJ-63576253): preclinical xenografts in Branch 2021 MCT (doi:10.1158/1535-7163.MCT-20-0510); the phase 1/2a primary endpoint was DLT, so it is unscored, as the draft says.

Enzalutamide's own F876L resistance models: Korpal 2013 Cancer Discov (doi:10.1158/2159-8290.CD-13-0142, PMID 23842682; resistant LNCaP-derived lines) and Balbas 2013 eLife (doi:10.7554/eLife.00499; mutagenesis screen) predicted F876L resistance; Azad 2015 Clin Cancer Res (doi:10.1158/1078-0432.CCR-14-2666) reported F876L in cfDNA of an enzalutamide-progressing patient and AR aberrations predicting lower PSA response. They could join the arn509-resistant-cell-lines-f876l track (product_in_model per drug) if enzalutamide is a member.
rule_questions: Safety: when the filed animal toxicity (dog convulsions at a Cmax at or near the human Cmax) predicts a harm at clinical exposure and patients show it at 0.2%, is that 'same' in direction, or does the magnitude need to be recorded as over_predicted?

Rule 6 opener: when the model's first use (2010 dog study) became public only in the same document that carries the comparison (2018 FDA review), is an untested opener at model_first_use_year still required? The draft skipped it and lint did not flag it.

Population mismatch for a member drug on its own model: if a castration-resistant (NHA-naive) xenograft is paired with a post-abiraterone phase 3 failure (proxalutamide), is the cell untested under 'conditions the model never tested', or contra?

Patient-level parallel tracks (efficacy 6): when the model predicts a resistance mutation and the patient datum is an exploratory cfDNA finding in progressing patients (not a trial endpoint, no carrier vs non-carrier comparison), does it count as an admissible 'primary' efficacy comparison, or should it be untested?
